recommendation: Proceed to an independent moderate-hard branch from model370 for lower action variation; preserve model340 and both-speed standard regressions as distinct baselines.

scope.duration_limitation: New fast-speed budgets are 24s; old model270 fast-speed and all 0.3 runs use 25s. Every new episode finishes before budget with zero timeouts.
scope.matching: Geometry, reset seeds, per-env initial root positions, aggregate initial pose distribution, heading control and both gates exactly match model270/0.3. Per-env initial quaternions are not stored.
scope.material_limitation: Material draws/parameters are not recorded; reset seeds do not resample startup material/dynamics. Separate construction draws need not match.
scope.metric_mean: Arithmetic mean of three seed-level aggregate metrics. Overall macro-means give each case equal weight; not pooled sample RMS.
scope.metric_scope: first episode until completion/fall/stall/escape/timeout; physics captured before auto-reset; smoothness excludes first second
scope.slip_metric_scope: foot-link horizontal speed while recent physics-step normal-contact history peaks >1N; proxy, not exact contact-point tangential slip
scope.acceptance_limitation: False motion flag reflects only the 1s pause gate. smoothness_verified remains False and visual review is required.

training_provenance.note: Range is read from training config; evaluation config records its own default range and does not establish training commands.
